blurb: Circle R Ranch is a summer camp and outdoor education centre on 220 acres of Carolinian forest, fields, and ponds. They offer programs for horse lovers, naturalists, camp enthusiasts, cross country skiers, and teachers. Activities include summer day camp, nature school programs, trail riding and lessons, mindfulness with animals, and cross country skiing and snowshoeing.
